recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No follow-up source work is needed for FHIR-18534 unless a future editorial pass chooses to normalize spacing or wording across the operations page independently of this issue.
issue_request: FHIR-18534 was a Published/Persuasive STU3 FHIR-core operations clarification from FHIR-I. It asked to change the Operation Definition parameter Profile bullet from saying a StructureDefinition applies restrictions about the resource to saying it describes restrictions about the parameter, only when the parameter type is a resource or data type.
initial_application: The Jira comment identifies git f7dd7bb655. That commit changed source/operations.html to the requested Profile wording, while its subject says GF#18530 because the same commit also applied the adjacent FHIR-18530 operations wording change.
additional_context: The current source root operations.html page is linked from source/documentation.html and remains in the current specification navigation. The current text says the Profile StructureDefinition describes additional restrictions about the parameter and is used only when the parameter type is a resource or datatype. The spelling normalization from "data type" to "datatype" is consistent with nearby current wording and does not change the rule.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current authoritative source already carries the substantive FHIR-18534 clarification, and the obsolete "applies additional restrictions about the resource" wording is absent from source.
